gen_risks.description: Insufficient deal flow and pipeline of startups for ISSF investments
gen_risks.mitigation: Collaboration with development partners, accelerators, and incubators to support pipeline development

gen_risks.description: Concentration risk due to limited number of VC funds and startups in Jordan
gen_risks.mitigation: Diversification of investments across various sectors and stages, and updating concentration limits

gen_risks.description: Dependence on lead investors for co-investment decisions
gen_risks.mitigation: Establishing a structured information-sharing mechanism with lead investors and conducting thorough due diligence

gen_risks.description: Limited capacity of ISSF staff to manage increased workload and responsibilities
gen_risks.mitigation: Hiring additional staff, providing training and capacity building, and outsourcing certain functions
gen_risks.evidence: Section III. PROJECT IMPLEMENTATION, A. Institutional and Implementation Arrangements

gen_risks.description: Inadequate environmental and social risk management
gen_risks.mitigation: Developing an Environmental and Social Management System (ESMS) and integrating E&S screening into the investment process
gen_risks.evidence: Section C. Environmental, Social and Legal Operational Policies

gen_risks.description: Non-compliance with World Bank's Environmental and Social Framework (ESF)
gen_risks.mitigation: Ensuring compliance with ESF, developing an Environmental and Social Commitment Plan (ESCP), and conducting regular monitoring and reporting
gen_risks.evidence: Section C. Environmental, Social and Legal Operational Policies

gen_risks.description: Inadequate governance and oversight of ISSF
gen_risks.mitigation: Strengthening governance arrangements, updating the Investment Strategy, and ensuring independence of the Investment Committee
gen_risks.evidence: Section II. PROJECT DESCRIPTION, ISSF Governance setup

gen_risks.description: Limited access to funding for female-led startups and SMEs
gen_risks.mitigation: Implementing targeted outreach measures, adopting a Gender Action Plan, and ensuring representation of female members on the ISSF Board
gen_risks.evidence: Section IV. PROJECT APPRAISAL SUMMARY, Gender

gen_risks.description: Insufficient investment in greentech startups and climate-responsive solutions
gen_risks.mitigation: Updating investment screening criteria to prioritize greentech and climate-responsive solutions, and allocating a minimum of 10% of investments to these areas
gen_risks.evidence: Section IV. PROJECT APPRAISAL SUMMARY, Climate co-benefits

gen_risks.description: Dependence on public funding and limited potential for self-sustainability
gen_risks.mitigation: Exploring new sources of funding, transitioning to a market-aligned structure, and ensuring commercial viability of investments
gen_risks.evidence: Section II. PROJECT DESCRIPTION, Long-Term Evolution

gen_risks.description: Inadequate monitoring and evaluation of project performance
gen_risks.mitigation: Developing a robust monitoring framework, conducting regular surveys and data collection, and ensuring data-driven decision-making
gen_risks.evidence: Section III. PROJECT IMPLEMENTATION, B. Results Monitoring, Evaluation, and Verification Arrangements

gen_risks.mitigation: Ensuring compliance with World Bank Procurement Regulations, hiring a qualified procurement specialist, and conducting regular procurement reviews

gen_risks.description: Limited capacity of Jordanian startups to absorb and utilize investments
gen_risks.mitigation: Providing capacity building support, mentoring, and coaching to eligible VC funds, startups, and SMEs

gen_risks.description: Dependence on international investors and potential risks associated with foreign investment
gen_risks.mitigation: Diversifying investor base, conducting thorough due diligence, and ensuring alignment with national development goals

gen_risks.description: Inadequate risk management and potential for investment losses
gen_risks.mitigation: Conducting thorough risk assessments, diversifying investments, and ensuring adequate risk management practices
gen_risks.evidence: Section IV. PROJECT APPRAISAL SUMMARY, Summary of economic and financial analysis

gt_risks.description: Macroeconomic risk is rated Substantial. External economic shocks, regional instability and related uncertainties, or a downturn in global venture capital markets could reduce investor confidence and slow private capital mobilization. Additionally, Jordan's nascent venture capital market and competition from more developed ecosystems in neighboring countries may impact startup retention and funding.

Other risks are rated Substantial and relate to geopolitical risk. Jordan's strategic location makes it susceptible to a complex set of geopolitical challenges that have intensified in recent years, due to the current Conflict in the Middle East and its repercussions for investment, trade, and tourism in the region. Increasing geopolitical risks may prompt adjustments in policy and budgetary priorities and/or contribute to delays in implementation.
gt_risks.mitigation: By combining regional and global diplomacy, building international partnerships, staying the course on political and economic modernization reforms, implementing prudent fiscal policies, and strategic security measures, Jordan has maintained its resilience and stability despite continuous crises.
